VaultConfig.title: VaultConfig
VaultConfig.description: User's zero-knowledge master password salt, AES-GCM verification canary, and dual-lock security settings.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the vault owner.

verifierIv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte GCM IV for the verification token.

passwordHint.description: Optional non-secret password hint (empty string if omitted).

biometricEnabled.description: Whether Layer 1 fingerprint/biometric verification is enabled.

autoLockSeconds.description: Background auto-lock timeout in seconds (0 = immediate).

VaultItem.title: VaultItem
VaultItem.description: Client-side AES-256-GCM encrypted credential, bank card, secure note, or identity document.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the item owner.

encryptedPayload.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the JSON item fields.

strengthScore.description: Password strength score from 0 to 4 (0 for non-password items).

/users/{userId}/vault_config/{configId}.description: Master vault cryptographic metadata and lock preferences (single doc 'master' per user).

/users/{userId}/vault_items/{itemId}.description: Encrypted password, card, note, and identity records owned by the user.
